decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already records the LDO source, power-board-absent activation condition, powered 3.3V scope, and standalone-programming purpose. The OR-ing details remain owned by the source Requirement.
The LED supply voltage and GPIO-controlled 5V rail are established by a separate clause of the message and are unchanged by the 3.3V source OR-ing decision.
The switched 5V boost behavior and loads are independent of the main-board 3.3V source OR-ing decision and are already represented by their own same-message MODIFY.
The battery voltage range and connection to AXP2101 come from a separate power-mapping clause. The OR-ing change does not alter the battery connector or interface state.
Selecting AXP2101 DCDC1 as the normal 3.3V source does not change the candidate's VMID-to-VSYS topology or net-label requirements.
The source concerns the main-board USB-C LDO path, not the power-board USB-C connector's data-line or sourceability requirements.
The power-source OR-ing decision does not change the interboard connector architecture, signals, pin-order policy, or unresolved physical numbering.
Powering I2C sensors from the selected 3.3V source does not alter the I2C clock, pull-ups, cable-length constraint, or series-resistor policy.
The 3.3V source OR-ing decision does not change the charge-status indicator, CHGLED connector, resistor values, or component population state.
The electrical source-selection behavior does not entail any change to board dimensions, orientation, mounting holes, connector placement, or enclosure fit.
The source-selection change does not alter the battery NTC sensing method or its J_BAT connection.
The normal-operation power path through AXP2101 does not modify the established overcharge, overdischarge, or thermal-protection requirements.
